title: Homogeneity Amplifies Data-Voids: Shared Failure on Low-Resource Languages Compounds Mistranslation Harms

original_idea.body:
# Homogeneity Amplifies Data-Voids: Shared Failure on Low-Resource Languages Compounds Mistranslation Harms

**Problem:** Failure mode A: poor performance / unsafe behavior on low-resource languages. Failure mode B: homogeneity. If all providers share the same low-resource blind spot, a safety-critical mistranslation (medical, legal) fails identically across every provider — no fallback exists.

**Direction:** Pick a low-resource language and a small set of safety-sensitive prompts (with verified reference answers). Query 5-6 open multilingual models. Measure inter-model agreement on errors and whether the same items fail across all models (correlated low-resource failure) vs a high-resource control. Report the 'no safe provider' rate.

**Why it matters:** Concentration means underserved-language communities face a correlated, inescapable safety gap. The correlation framing (not per-model accuracy) is novel and policy-relevant; fully doable by outside researchers with open models.

**Relevant context:** Artificial Hivemind shared blind spots; multilingual-LLM safety/quality literature; concentration risk (International AI Safety Report 2026).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Correlated low-resource failures are a real harm but a diffuse fairness/reliability concern with a gap to catastrophic AI risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Querying multilingual models is easy but requires reference answers / native-speaker verification in a low-resource language.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused 'no safe provider' rate with a control; reference-answer curation is the main dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open multilingual models, no lab access; underserved-language scrutiny is independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only on a small prompt set; trivial compute.

novelty.reasoning: Low-resource failure studied; cross-provider correlation framing may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Low-resource failures studied; cross-provider correlation may be open.
